name: manual_a3b5a9
claim: A safety invariant enforced by a consumer during permit ingestion (such as rejecting authority versions prior to a pruned anchor floor: R_p >= anchor_version) is a consumer-local Step 4.3 acknowledgement coverage check, NOT a shared wire grant refusal code. Cross-repository wire vocabularies require dedicated two-repo contract amendments; expressing local gate failures as wire refusal codes couples consumer retention policy to issuer grant format.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: Claude review row 5256 caught an attempt to add grant.below_anchor_floor to shared refusal codes. Step 4.3 Rule 4 acknowledgement coverage enforces the invariant locally without modifying the shared Part 1 wire vocabulary.

rationale: 2026-10-19: Claude review row 5256 caught an attempt to add grant.below_anchor_floor to shared refusal codes. Step 4.3 Rule 4 acknowledgement coverage enforces the invariant locally without modifying the shared Part 1 wire vocabulary.
